criteria.h1: The lesson roster that schedules where your child stands at 6am Saturday
tableRows: Easy AppointmentsDocumented self-hosted appointment plugin marketed for service businesses (plugin version 4.0.3). WordPress admin screens cover locations, services, workers, an appointments list, a customer list, custom form fields, and CSV export. A Saturday 6:00am learn-to-skate slot or a rink-entrance access note is a booking you create; a service name such as ice rink or learn-to-skate is a label you configure. Neither is a documented default. Rink/entrance, Saturday-slot, child-name-and-age, skill-level, coach, competition-travel, or emergency-contact questions are custom fields you add (textarea, select, input, or checkbox); they are not documented defaults. A booking is a calendar row, not proof a child skates anywhere — and a CSV export of "North entrance / Sat 6:00am — Snowplow Sam 2 + named aged child" next to a coach assignment is still a calendar that holds which patch of ice holds which child under one ice-rink reservation. Emails can include those custom fields and copy the appointment off-site. An optional GDPR setting can auto-remove customer data older than six months; that is not a default purge. Google Calendar, SMS, and payments are Pro. Google reCAPTCHA is optional. Public booking-form browser hosts are unverified. | Ice-rink lesson bookings stored on your WordPress site | Browser hosts not verified | Not assessed | Not tested | None | WordPress.org listingv4.0.3 readme.txt (SVN)
